attempted_claim: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 3, G a finite abelian group of order prime to 3, and V a two-dimensional principally realized Yetter-Drinfeld module over kG with braiding matrix of Drinfeld-Jimbo Cartan type B2: q11=q, q22=q^2 and q12*q21=q^(-2) for q in k* a primitive Nth root of unity with N greater than 2 and 3 not dividing N, so B(V) is finite-dimensional as in characteristic zero. Classify up to Hopf algebra isomorphism all finite-dimensional pointed Hopf algebras H over k with coradical kG and infinitesimal braiding V, over every such G and realization in this scope. Present each H by explicit generators extending B(V)#kG with deformed quantum Serre relations and deformed short- and long-root power relations adapted to characteristic 3 including which quantum binomial coefficients vanish mod 3, state exact vanishing and centrality constraints on the lifting scalars, exhibit for each H an explicit multiplicative Hopf 2-cocycle or Hochschild 2-cocycle ledger entry on B(V)#kG witnessing H as a cocycle deformation, and give necessary and sufficient isomorphism conditions on the parameters. A complete answer is the explicit finite family list with relations, parameter constraints, cocycle witnesses, and isomorphism dichotomy covering every object in scope.
claim_type: complete modular lifting classification with mod-3 Serre/power deformations and isomorphism dichotomy
decisive_failure: originality: Nearest priors substantively cover the claim: Beattie-Dascaleseu-Raianu 2002 computes B2 liftings with Serre/power deformations (odd n≠5), and Angiono-Garcia Iglesias 2016-2019 classifies all diagonal-type liftings as cocycle deformations with chi/g constraints and isomorphism scaling in characteristic zero. Under the admitted 3∤|G|,3∤N hypotheses kG stays semisimple and every denominator stays a unit, so the draft itself concedes no new mod-3 vanishing and characteristic-free N=4/N=5 arithmetic. The char-3 list is therefore a mechanical characteristic transport/repackaging of known stronger char-0 B2/diagonal results, not a new boundary, encoding, or database fact.

record_title: Liftings of Cartan type B2 in characteristic 3
recovery_conditions: state a substantive result not covered by the identified prior work; address the recorded limitation: Scope is exactly as admitted: k algebraically closed of characteristic 3, G finite abelian of order prime to 3, principal rank-2 realization of Cartan type B2 with N>2 and 3 not dividing N. Cases with 3 dividing N or 3 dividing |G|, non-principal realizations, and non-Cartan braidings are excluded and the ledger denominators would fail there. The J12/J112 correction polynomials are characterized by the Delta-primitivity recursion with unit q-coefficients rather than printed term-by-term.
